content_text: Dear master Roger I just saw your one of your BTS picture on Old asc magazines. There is a one incandescent bulb you were holding but above there is bunch of different bulbs. I know it’s your part of your lighting tricks. For which film you have done that kind of incandescent lamp lighting. Why did you change the bulb shape above. Did you use same watts. What kind of wrapper you used?
